text: The applicant must be over 18 years old (inclusive) and under 45 years old (inclusive), in good health, comply with the relevant provisions of the "Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China", and be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign ordinary passport. 2. According to the document No. 12 issued by the Ministry of Education (Educational Department Letter [2020] 12), it is stipulated: If both or one of the applicant's parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled abroad, and the applicant was born with foreign nationality, they must present a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for a period of 4 years (inclusive) or more. Moreover, they must have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least 2 years during the last 4 years (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025). One year of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.Academic qualifications must meet the following conditions:(1) Graduating high school students. They must obtain a high school graduation certificate before the year of admission in the same year; otherwise, their admission qualification will be invalid.(2) Individuals who already have a high school graduation certificate.The applicant's Chinese language proficiency must meet the requirements for professional study:The Chinese International Education major requires a HSK 4 level score of 180 points, while other majors require a Chinese language proficiency of at least HSK 5 level with a score of 180 points.
